# Additional characters

Barbarian, Knight, Mage, Rogue and Rogue Hooded by Kay Lousberg.
Source: https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Character-Pack-Adventures-1.0
Pack: https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-adventurers
License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0). See ../vendor/KAYKIT-LICENSE.txt.
Downloaded 2026-09-22 from the creator's repository.

Original GLB files include embedded textures, a skeleton, and authored animation clips.
Runtime normalizes height, hides alternate weapons, and selects idle/walk/run/jump animations.
Original outfits are preserved. All additional models are included locally and can be exported offline.

Skeleton Mage, Minion, Rogue and Warrior: https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Character-Pack-Skeletons-1.0
CC0 license: ../vendor/KAYKIT-SKELETONS-LICENSE.txt. Original embedded hat, hood, helmet and cloak meshes can be toggled without changing their authored rig attachment. Downloaded 2026-09-23.
